statement.zh: 象岛城镇—神庙项目首季正式结果见 Kaiser 等 MDAIK 26（1970），开启 DAI 长期田野系列。
statement.en: At Elephantine, the town-and-temple project’s inaugural formal season results are documented in Kaiser et al. MDAIK 26 (1970), beginning the DAI long-term field series.
